λύκος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX for זְאֵב ;]
a wolf: Mat.10:16, Luk.10:3, Jhn.10:12; figuratively (as Eze.22:27, Zep.3:3, Jer.5:6, al.), Mat.7:1, Act.20:29.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: “Beware of false prophets, who come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly are ravening wolves.
Go your ways. Behold, I send you out as lambs among wolves.
He who is a hired hand, and not a shepherd, who doesn’t own the sheep, sees the wolf coming, leaves the sheep, and flees. The wolf snatches the sheep, and…
For I know that after my departure, vicious wolves will enter in among you, not sparing the flock.
